svg.title: Complete Monster database: numbers to globe and back
svg.desc: Every one of 40,348 canonical archive bytes moves from its numbered atlas slot onto a rotating globe and returns to the same slot. The embedded archive decodes to 194 irreducible degrees, all 37,636 character-table cells, and 221 ragged McKay-Thompson prefixes containing 8,501 coefficients.
svg.text: complete finite archive · 40,348 indexed bytes · 24-second lossless loop

g.text: 221 labelled finite McKay–Thompson prefixes · 8,501 supplied coefficients
Each mark retains source index i and byte value; motion changes only (x,y).
The SVG metadata embeds the same canonical archive with framing and SHA-256.
Lean proves globe decoding returns every byte and all three finite datasets exactly.
